key_provisions_or_claims: Defines minimum data exchanges, hardware and safety requirements for robot-lift integration (digital and discrete controllers).
Covers robot integration with automatic doorways (swing and sliding doors).
Addresses communications in emergencies such as fire evacuation and power outage.
Harmonised with ISO (DIS) 21423 from TC299 WG10.
Excludes specific message protocols and low-energy power-assisted doors.
annotation.summary_en: ISO/AWI 26159-2 is a new standard project (ISO/TC 299) specifying requirements for integrating robots with lifts (elevators) and automatic doorways, including data exchanges, hardware, safety, and emergency or abnormal conditions. It is part of a series on infrastructure for robot applications, registered November 2025.
